problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 31 units
* Package 2: size 68 units
* Package 3: size 40 units
* Package 4: size 49 units
* Package 5: size 45 units
* Package 6: size 55 units
* Package 7: size 61 units
* Package 8: size 53 units
* Package 9: size 52 units
* Package 10: size 35 units
* Package 11: size 67 units
* Package 12: size 57 units
* Package 13: size 37 units
* Package 14: size 31 units
* Package 15: size 41 units
* Package 16: size 30 units
* Package 17: size 68 units
* Package 18: size 64 units
* Package 19: size 47 units
* Package 20: size 52 units
* Package 21: size 43 units
* Package 22: size 54 units
* Package 23: size 42 units
* Package 24: size 50 units
* Package 25: size 41 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Each package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
